automations.name: review-request
automations.description: After a push that is not a base-only update: clear hands-reviewed and request the external review once with review-this; never while hands-reviewing is present. After the external review failed to run (its could-not-run comment, or hands-review-failed): request it once more, and not again at the same head.

automations.name: ci-rerun
automations.description: After a CI failure that is the runner's, not the change's: re-run the failed jobs once per head.

automations.name: gates-green
automations.description: When both reviews are READY and CI passed at the head and no external review is in flight: drop the WIP prefix and the draft, and submit the attempt.

automations.name: base-update
automations.description: After CI at a head, when an external review that held the update ends with CI concluded at the head, and when the last running check concludes under a failure (and again after each re-run), unless an external review is in flight: merge the base into a branch behind it and push without force when the patch identity is unchanged, with the delta note (the reviews stand); a conflict or a changed identity is a fix turn for the worker; a branch up to date costs one fetch.
